facts.conditions: Section 8 is application guidance, not component specification. VOL depends on load and drive, not a constant drop. Duty waveform, board/ambient thermal conditions and actual load currents are required before any continuous-load conclusion. Recommended junction range is separately -40..125 C in section 5.3; 150 C in section 5.1 is a stress limit, not an operating target. Exact ULN2003ADR ambient scope is -40..70 C (page 4 ULN200xA row; exact orderable page 23); 125 C is junction temperature, never ambient authorization.

source_issues.description: Proposed coil resistance/current/inductance and stored energy, switching frequency/duty, simultaneous active channels, ambient, board and target junction margin are unspecified. Continuous operation and protection are UNKNOWN; no universal safe current is inferred.

Controller output-high voltage versus delivered input current, aggregate GPIO current, temperature and selected load current are unspecified. ON/saturation compatibility is UNKNOWN. Existing 25 C points do not guarantee other conditions.

Figure 5-4 is D-package at TA=70 C in Typical Characteristics; input drive, waveform frequency and board details are not stated there. No numeric interpolation or guaranteed all-condition current envelope is recorded. DYY, AI and other-manufacturer transfer is excluded.

COM connection and clamp stress/forward-drop data do not specify a complete allowable coil energy, repetition-rate, surge or fault budget for the proposed load. Supply absorption and transient waveform are unknown; protection sign-off remains unavailable.
